categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Jindun Fans Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-end intelligent ventilation system equipment manufacturing and design. Its core business segments include ventilation systems for rail transit, nuclear power engineering, national defense equipment, low-altitude economy, and marine technology. The company also engages in mechanical and electrical equipment installation and construction services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI integration with ventilation systems, digital fans, and multi-field coupling technologies for ducted propellers. It employs intelligent manufacturing, lean production, ERP systems, and additive manufacturing. Core production processes include in-house machining of key components, assembly, system integration, and rigorous quality control supported by CNAS and AMCA accredited testing laboratories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises and government projects in sectors like urban rail transit, nuclear power plants, national defense, low-altitude aviation, and marine engineering. The company serves domestic markets predominantly, with emerging international markets including Middle East, Europe, and Southeast Asia under the Belt and Road initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province. It has established offices in multiple domestic cities and is expanding its market presence internationally, focusing on Southeast Asia and Belt and Road countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Jindun Fans operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing, assembly, and system integration of ventilation equipment. It sources raw materials like carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and key components such as motors from suppliers, maintaining strategic partnerships to ensure supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent and digital ventilation technologies, including AI-enabled digital fans and ducted propeller development for low-altitude economy applications. It invests in R&D collaborations with top universities like Tsinghua and Zhejiang University, focusing on energy efficiency, noise reduction, and integration of multi-field coupling technologies. Future R&D priorities include nuclear fusion cooling fans, permanent magnet metro fans, and marine ventilation solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ventilation system products and related mechanical and electrical installation services. The company operates on a project-based sales model, winning contracts via public tenders, and provides full-cycle services from design to after-sales maintenance. It also earns rental income from leasing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-end ventilation system equipment provider in China, ranking among the top three in market share across its core sectors. It competes with other specialized ventilation and mechanical equipment manufacturers domestically and internationally, leveraging proprietary technologies and strategic alliances to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 522 million, representing a 7.52% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 12.53 million, up 21.73%. The company maintains a stable asset base of around RMB 1.48 billion and continues to invest in R&D, with expenditures of RMB 20.7 million in 2024. Despite some cash flow fluctuations, the company shows a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Jindun Fans differentiates itself through high-performance, reliable, and energy-efficient ventilation solutions tailored for critical infrastructure sectors. Its products integrate intelligent control, digital monitoring, and predictive maintenance capabilities. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, strategic academic partnerships, and comprehensive quality management system create a competitive moat, enabling customized solutions for complex applications such as nuclear power and defense.
